headline: NSK Steering Systems Co., Ltd. Hit by Ransomware Attack, Operations Halted
body: NSK Steering Systems Co., Ltd., a leading automotive components supplier, has fallen victim to a ransomware attack that has brought its operations to a standstill. The cyber incident compromised the company's domain infrastructure and affected hundreds of devices. As a result, ongoing projects have been delayed. Additionally, attackers managed to steal internal data, further complicating the situation. NSK Steering Systems Co., Ltd. has engaged incident response teams to restore its systems and mitigate the impact of the attack.
